plan: Drive: from Fort Ware, about 12 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 57.50344, -125.70692, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.3 km NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 151 m, about 122 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 90 m SE of the spot at 783 m (57.52507, -125.62651). Water: unnamed wetland 30 m NW (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-41, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-03-14, closures 2026-10-16.
